code_discovery.notes: Do not create a fourth logging format. Converge T0GM canonical event provenance, Signal event/trace infrastructure and Governance TraceContext into one structured logging/telemetry envelope. T0GM already carries company context, actor/source/subject, lineage, risk, oversight and evidence. Signal already carries timestamps, trace/correlation/root causation, severity, checksums, payload/metadata and event storage/query infrastructure. Governance carries company/trace/correlation/causation context and telemetry sinks.
schema_convergence_findings: Signal schema uses legacy scope values tenant/system. Canonical Titan Zero boundary is company_id; tenant terminology must be normalized as compatibility input only.

T0GM schema models company_id as string while Signal currently models company_id as integer/null and Governance TraceContext uses string. Select one canonical cross-runtime representation and adapt legacy inputs at boundaries.
Signal event schema is additionalProperties=false while T0GM event schema permits additionalProperties=true; standardization needs explicit extension/metadata policy rather than accidental drift.
